$comment: Design-layer content catalog for gem-based imbue recipes. Consumed by ContentProvider (LoadImbueRecipes) and used by ImbueWithGemCommandHandler for the gem-driven imbue path. Taper-based imbues remain in the legacy keyword flow (ImbueService.ResolveImbueType). Keep gem IDs in sync with items shipped in loot-tables.json dropPools.

gems.description: Neutral enchantment substrate. Grants +1 to any imbue attempt's success chance.
Budget hybrid gem. Produces Fire or Earth imbues at half strength.
Required gem for wyrd/aether imbues. Carries aether affinity.
Required gem for earth imbues. Reduces damage taken and improves armor.
Required gem for fire and air imbues. Increases damage and speed.
Required gem for water imbues. Grants heal-on-hit and weave regen effects.
Universal gem. Unlocks high-tier imbues and can upgrade an existing imbue one power tier.
Master-tier wyrd imbue gem. High-variance powerful effect; Fairgean boss drop.

recipes.description: Using Quartz as a pre-imbuing substrate grants +10% success chance on the next imbuing attempt. Does not consume an imbue slot.
Obsidian carries a residual fire affinity — half the strength of a Fire Shaping Taper but much more plentiful.
Obsidian's volcanic stone-body anchors a modest Earth imbue at half strength.
Amethyst resonates with wyrd/aether currents — standard-strength Wyrd imbue.
Emerald produces a potent Earth imbue, stronger than the baseline Earth Shaping Taper.
Topaz carries a sharp, aggressive fire resonance. Potent Fire imbue.
Topaz also channels an air-speed resonance — use the same gem to commit either a Fire OR Air imbue at craft time.
Aquamarine is the canonical Water imbue gem — heal-on-hit and weave-regen flavor.
Diamond is consumed to upgrade an EXISTING imbue on an item by one power tier (doubles its power component). Works on any imbue type. Requires CraftingSkill >= 5.
Alternative use: Diamond can seed a high-tier Fire imbue directly (master-crafter only; CraftingSkill >= 8).
Alternative use: Diamond high-tier Earth imbue (CraftingSkill >= 8).
Alternative use: Diamond high-tier Water imbue (CraftingSkill >= 8).
Alternative use: Diamond high-tier Air imbue (CraftingSkill >= 8).
Master-tier Wyrd imbue. High variance: actual power rolls between (power - variance) and (power + variance). The Maw does not give a clean edge.

compatibility.comment: Which gem alignments are permitted for each imbue type. Reserved for future validation; current gem-imbue flow resolves exclusively via recipe id.
